verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of recurring scheduled execution is that ObsessionDB supports ClickHouse refreshable materialized views. These re-run a query on a schedule, but the support appears only as a single item in a feature-status list. The batch SQL jobs (docs-15) are one-off runs with pause, retry and cancel, not recurring schedules. The interval-based alert rules (docs-21) are monitoring checks rather than general jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose job or workflow scheduler, cron-style scheduling of arbitrary SQL or pipelines, agent-driven scheduling, schedule management and observability docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
